name: Zardeth of the Black Claw
summary: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Zardeth of the Black Claw guards a hidden warlock cabal. He lives in chambers beneath the Slaughtered Lamb and passes as an ordinary patron. When curious nobles look too closely, he ends their inquiries for good.

sections.title: A Shadow Beneath the Lamb
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, tunnels shelter those who practice darker arts. Above them, the Mage Quarter's spires study arcane discipline in the open. Zardeth of the Black Claw works in the crypts and guards warlocks hiding beneath the city guard's nose. The Alliance condemns fel magic, so the cabal keeps its presence secret and removes threats before royal investigators arrive.

sections.title: Silencing the Nobility
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock heard whispers of the hidden warlock coven and urged the House of Nobles to begin a full investigation. Zardeth feared that scrutiny would destroy the enclave beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, so he arranged a secret response. The lord favored fine liquor. Zardeth sent an operative across the eastern kingdoms to gather two rare, lethal plants: the Tear of Tilloa from Duskwood and Musquash Root from beneath the Stonewrought Dam.

sections.title: A Noble Brew
sections.body: Zardeth mixed the gathered plants with stout ale to make Black Claw Stout, a lethal drink disguised as an ordinary luxury gift. The poisoned brew reached Wishock's estate and killed him swiftly and quietly. With the lord dead, his campaign ended before the crown could intervene. Zardeth and the other warlocks kept their hidden enclave beneath the Slaughtered Lamb safe.

faq.q: Who is Zardeth of the Black Claw?
faq.answer: Zardeth is a human warlock who guards the hidden brotherhood in the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He deflects suspicion and handles threats to the warlocks' secret presence in the city.

Zardeth can be found beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in the southern half of Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. Enter the tavern, find the passage descending at the back, and follow the winding catacombs to the warlock enclave.

faq.q: Why does Zardeth want Lord Wishock dead?
faq.answer: Lord Baurles K. Wishock found evidence of warlocks beneath Stormwind and urged the city's nobility to investigate. An official inquiry could have led the authorities to root out and execute the Slaughtered Lamb coven.

Black Claw Stout is a lethal drink Zardeth brewed from stout and two rare poisonous plants, the Tear of Tilloa from Darkshire and Musquash Root from the Wetlands. He made it look like an expensive vintage to quietly kill Lord Wishock.
The Black Claw is Zardeth's affiliation or title within Stormwind's hidden warlock network. Its members evade the Stormwind guard and the Kirin Tor, using lethal measures to protect their secrecy.

faq.q: Why are warlocks allowed in Stormwind at all?
faq.answer: Warlocks are not openly tolerated in Stormwind, so they hide in the cellars beneath the Slaughtered Lamb. The authorities may turn a blind eye for pragmatic reasons, or remain unaware because agents like Zardeth kill those who prepare to expose the warlocks.

angles.text: As a human warlock, Zardeth shows the cold pragmatism some rely on to survive in the heart of the Alliance, where survival can depend on pre-emptive killings.
For an Alliance loyalist, Zardeth reveals a corrupt underbelly beneath Stormwind's gleaming streets.
As a herbalist, you can see how Zardeth's plot turns poisonous plants like the Tear of Tilloa and Musquash Root into lethal tools.
